8.encoding: empty bytes for initial admission; original predecessor UUID for a independently approved successor

10.encoding: exact stored UTC microseconds multiplied by 1000

state.digest: pc.control.transition-state.v1; SHA-256 over canonical typed CBOR; every map field required

transition.change: one immutable bounded Fact or candidate selection, exact installed target host, source and archive binding, independent approval, attempt and business intent commit with the admission receipt and outbox; no physical effect or transport success is asserted

authority.action: exact action registry, live scoped authority fence

evidence.format: identity credential signed by the authorized checker
evidence.binding: exact immutable candidate, action, scope, expected revision and distinct checker; consumed by this operation
actual operator, session, action, candidate digest and one-time challenge consumed by this operation

authority.snapshot: retained exact precommit authority path and live epochs/validity; no session or credential secrets
authority.approval: EXACT_CONSUMED_CANDIDATE_WITH_INDEPENDENT_MAKER_CHECKER; deferred owning-row trigger binds approval and before/after state

events.payload: canonical four-key CommandCommitted CBOR; commandId=operationId, aggregateRef=canonical aggregate URN, actionIntentId, intentDigest=actionIntentDigest
events.effect: one durable Control admission before target I/O; target signature verification, current target predicates, physical effect, cancellation and outcome reconciliation remain separate obligations

privacy.placement: same participant and privacy domain as authoritative aggregate
privacy.read: current read authorization required; receipt is never authorization
privacy.retention: retain receipt, typed state/authority inputs, authorization evidence, public trust and operation links under control audit retention; no automatic deletion

lifecycle.idempotency: exact replay returns original operation, receipt, evidence and event IDs/bytes/sequences
lifecycle.rollback: admission, evidence, signing attempt, head, event and operation result all roll back; no target I/O is allowed from an uncommitted transaction
lifecycle.restart: scoped primary operation reconciliation; preserve UNKNOWN for unresolved COMMIT
lifecycle.delivery: only committed primary readback may issue the finite host/scope/store-bound request; a hold or policy change blocks new dispatch and requires durable cancellation of unresolved attempts; absent or ambiguous target readback remains UNKNOWN; a successor preserves exact business intent and selection and requires original authenticated terminal no-effect outcome plus independent approval and fresh step-up Dispatch cannot outlive the receipt-bound deadline, at most 60 seconds after admission; expiry requires cancellation/readback and fresh independent successor approval, never renewed execution authority.

requestBinding.encoding: UTF-8 domain plus NUL; each field prefixed by uint32 big-endian UTF-8 byte length; SHA-256
